understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, while completing levels efficiently and ultimately winning the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions trigger automatic movement in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a spike, reaching the goal, or otherwise stopping. The fall-destination previews indicate where each move will land, and passage columns lead to new sections. CLICK at a target coordinate removes clickable breakable blocks without advancing the rising-platform timer, allowing gravity paths to open. Landing on u or v spikes ends the attempt; each level allows two attempts with 50 turns each. UNDO reverts the previous action and can recover from a bad move or click.
